'''Zack Simmons''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Centerville tournament]] on 8 July 2000 with Court (CCT), according to Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d990">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-10-centerville-ohio-7-8-00d990/ centerville-ohio-7-8-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 10 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-10-centerville-ohio-7-8-00d990/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
